verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax has a documented public API. The standalone Tax Calculations and Tax Transactions APIs calculate tax, record transactions and handle reversals, with an API reference page and documented parameters and fields (shipping_cost, IP-based location, taxability_reason). Registrations can also be managed through a Tax Registrations API, and llms.txt and markdown docs are served for agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
